attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Vermont state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus based on "doing business" standard.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in VT (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "VT" streq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets VT economic nexus ("doing business" standard)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "VT" streq and

action_details.action_postfix: "VT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" job.audit_trail swap addto
"VT filing required due to economic nexus (doing business standard). Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5833" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VT nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate VT state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT state additions and subtractions; Calculate VT-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "VT income adjustments calculated. Reference: 32 V.S.A. 5832" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No VT nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No VT nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate VT state corporate income tax. Applies VT graduated tax rates (6.0%, 7.0%, 8.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. VT has one of the highest top corporate tax rates in the nation at 8.5%.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax using graduated brackets (6%, 7%, 8.5%)
No VT nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.vt_calculated_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VT nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
